title: bee close refuses while a dissent has no verdict, in every lane
action:
Add the dissent-debt door to `bee close` (Phase 2 of docs/history/slp-dissent-stop-and-ask/plan.md, per a2affcba and 4b7aa303). `bee close` must REFUSE while any dissent on this feature's cells lacks a verdict.

The plan's Phase 2 row says "one more arm in an existing builder". That is INCOMPLETE, and the shape below is the corrected one — a recorded deviation, verified against the source. Three things beyond the arm are real work:

A. THE SHARED DEBT HELPERS go in `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/dissent.rs`, NOT in close.rs. Phase 3 gives `bee worktree merge` the same door and must read the SAME helper and the SAME escape. Precedent for the placement: `feature_proof_check` at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/proof.rs:48 is `pub(crate)` in the cells module, called by close.rs:1865 AND by packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/phases.rs:156, both as `crate::verbs::cells::feature_proof_check(...)`. `verbs/cells/mod.rs:472` already glob-re-exports dissent.rs (`pub(crate) use self::dissent::*;`), so no mod.rs edit is needed.

  - `feature_dissent_debt(root, feature)` — count plus the offending cell ids, mirroring the `DebtSummary` shape at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs:218. An offender is a cell of this feature carrying a `dissent` trace entry for which `dissent_is_answered` is false. That reader already exists — `dissent_is_answered` at dissent.rs:291, `pub(crate)`, and its own doc comment at dissent.rs:1060 calls itself "the ONE reading of 'unanswered' the debt doors will share". USE IT. Do not write a second reading. Keep its corrupt-row semantics exactly as they are (a non-object row counts as ANSWERED, so a corrupt row never blocks forever) — a test pins that.
  - `has_dissent_deferral_decision(root, feature)` — a fourth copy of the 12-line escape at close.rs:405-418 (`has_judge_deferral_decision`), with the tag `dissent-deferral`. Its siblings are `has_capture_deferral_decision` (close.rs:566), `has_uat_deferral_decision`, and `has_knowledge_freshness_deferral_decision` (close.rs:581). Same `DecisionFilters { tag, feature }` whole-token feature match, no new matching rule.

B. THE ARCHIVE-INCLUSIVE LISTER DOES NOT EXIST IN THE SHAPE THIS NEEDS. `list_cells_including_archive` at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/guard.rs:523 IS archive-inclusive (live store first, then `.bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json`, live copy wins on a duplicate id) — but it filters by ONE exact status string, and every caller today passes `"capped"`. A dissent lives on a cell in ANY status: a `blocker` dissent leaves the cell `blocked`, a `consider` dissent leaves it `open` or `claimed`. Copying `"capped"` ships a door blind to exactly the cells a blocker dissent parks.

  Generalize the parameter to `Option<&str>` where `None` means every status, mirroring the shape `list_cells` already uses at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/read.rs:123, and update the existing call sites to pass `Some("capped")`. A sibling function that skips the filter is acceptable if the generalization ripples further than the call sites; say which you chose and why in the cap report.

C. THE REFUSAL IS A SECOND, SEPARATE BLOCK. The `Door` pushed by the builder does not refuse on its own. `build_close_report_doors` at close.rs:1420 returns `Vec<Door>` (the struct is at close.rs:683-688: `door`, `blocking`, `detail`, `command`), and `close_handler` at close.rs:1826 carries one hand-written refusal block per blocking door. The judge one is close.rs:2017-2047: it tests `doors.iter().any(|d| d.door == "judge-debt" && d.blocking)`, re-reads the debt for its ids, and prints three lines — a headline behind a pinned prefix const, then `remedy: ...`, then `next: ...` — exiting 1. Write the matching block for `dissent-debt`, and add a pinned `CLOSE_DISSENT_DEBT_PREFIX` const beside `CLOSE_JUDGE_DEBT_PREFIX` at close.rs:42.

THE ARM ITSELF. Copy the judge-debt arm at close.rs:1457-1517 for its structure — the deferred/archived/plain three-way `detail`, and `command` set to `Some("bee cells unarchive")` when any offender is archived, else the record verb. THREE THINGS MUST NOT BE COPIED:

  1. The lane gate. close.rs:1462 reads `if matches!(feature_route(root, feature)?.as_deref(), Some("standard") | Some("high-risk")) {`. a2affcba is UNCONDITIONAL — the dissent door exists in EVERY lane, `tiny` included. Do not wrap the arm in that `if`.
  2. The grandfather cutoff `JUDGE_DOOR_INTRODUCED_AT` (close.rs:382-390). A dissent record cannot predate the feature that created it.
  3. The `behavior_change`-only filter. A dissent is recorded against any cell.

Detect archived offenders the way the judge arm does (close.rs:1466-1474): `!crate::verbs::cells::cell_file(root, id).exists() && crate::verbs::cells::resolve_cell_file(root, id).is_some()`. Unarchive-first is correct here for the same reason it is correct for judge — `dissent-verdict` writes through `mutate_cell`, and that funnel refuses an archived cell outright (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/util.rs:273). The verb spellings are `bee cells unarchive --feature <feature>` (util.rs:102, util.rs:273) and `bee cells dissent-verdict` (util.rs:99).

REMEDY WORDING follows house style. Match these, which are the live strings:
  - close.rs:2036 — "remedy: run bee cells judge to check, then bee cells judge-record to record a verdict for each cell above."
  - close.rs:2033-2034 — "remedy: some of the cells above are archived — run bee cells unarchive --feature {feature} first, then ..."
  - close.rs:2001 — "remedy: run bee-capturing to record the capture, or log a decision tagged capture-deferral naming \"{feature}\" to defer it."
  - close.rs:2044 — "next: settle the judge debt above, then re-run bee close --feature {feature}"
The dissent remedy must name the `dissent-deferral` escape the same way close.rs:2001 names `capture-deferral`.

TESTS go in `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/tests.rs` — the judge close-door tests live there, not in drivers/tests.rs, and the comment at tests.rs:2036-2041 says so. Judge existing coverage first, then author only the gap, RED FIRST. Mirror these cases, which are the precedent:
  - `judge_debt_door_blocks_a_standard_lane_feature_with_an_unjudged_cell` (tests.rs:2069)
  - `judge_debt_door_clears_once_a_judge_verdict_is_recorded` (tests.rs:2088)
  - `close_refuses_judge_debt_for_a_standard_lane_feature` (tests.rs:2147) — end-to-end through `close_handler`, asserting the three-line refusal
  - `judge_debt_door_clears_with_a_logged_judge_deferral_decision` (tests.rs:2328) — shows the decisions.jsonl seeding AND the different-feature negative
  - `judge_debt_door_names_unarchive_first_for_an_archived_offender` (tests.rs:2355) — asserts unarchive is named BEFORE the record verb and `command == Some("bee cells unarchive")`
The lane case INVERTS: where `judge_debt_door_is_absent_for_a_tiny_lane_feature` (tests.rs:2103) asserts absence, the dissent twin asserts the door IS present and blocking on a `tiny` lane. Fixtures are `tempfile::tempdir()` roots with `write_lane_record_routed`, `write_cell_fixture`, and `write_archived_cell_fixture` (tests.rs:8001).

Do not touch `verbs/worktree/phases.rs` — the merge door is Phase 3 and reads these same helpers. Finish the helpers COMPLETELY here so Phase 3 needs no edit in dissent.rs.

truths: A feature with one unanswered dissent makes bee close refuse, naming the offending cell id and the remedy.
Recording the verdict makes bee close go green with no other change.
The door blocks a tiny-lane feature exactly as it blocks a high-risk one.
An unanswered dissent on an ARCHIVED cell still blocks, and the remedy names bee cells unarchive --feature <feature> first.
An unanswered dissent on a BLOCKED cell blocks the door — the debt count is not limited to capped cells.
A logged decision tagged dissent-deferral naming this feature clears the door; the same tag naming a different feature does not.
Several unanswered dissents make the door name every one of them, never just the first.
A feature with no dissent at all reports the door clear and closes exactly as it does today.
artifacts: The dissent-debt arm in build_close_report_doors plus its refusal block and pinned prefix const in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs
A status-agnostic archive-inclusive cell lister in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/guard.rs
The dissent close-door cases in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/tests.rs, each proven red first
key_links: The door reads dissent_is_answered (dissent.rs:291), never a second reading of unanswered.
The debt helper and the deferral escape live in verbs/cells/dissent.rs so Phase 3's merge door reaches them through crate::verbs::cells:: with no further edit.
The refusal reaches the user through close_handler, not only through the doors array.
prohibitions: The arm is NOT wrapped in the standard/high-risk lane gate at close.rs:1462.
No grandfather cutoff and no behavior_change filter is copied onto the dissent arm.
verbs/worktree/phases.rs is not changed by this cell.
No existing judge, capture, uat, or proof door assertion is weakened or deleted.
The corrupt-row semantics of dissent_is_answered are unchanged.
